entities.label: Person
entities.summary: David Vega Hernández is a Spanish professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP doubles ranking of world No. 28 achieved on 21 July 2014. He also has a career high ATP singles ranking of No. 403 achieved on 13 February 2023. Hernández has won five ATP Tour doubles titles. He competes mainly on the ATP Challenger Tour where he has won 13 doubles titles.
